split_policy.note: hash-based so a duplicated FEN always lands in the same split

cp_perspective.determined_by: empirical material-sign correlation over 3189 sampled positions

known_limitations: Source FENs carry only 4 fields, so halfmove/fullmove clocks are absent; meta slots 6 and 7 are forced to 0 on BOTH the training and inference paths (board.INCLUDE_CLOCKS_DEFAULT) to avoid train/serve skew.
The model therefore has no 50-move-rule or repetition awareness from this data.
puzzle_source: Lichess puzzle database (lichess_db_puzzle.csv.zst), used only for the retroactive puzzle_report.json evaluation, not for training
